data.one_liner: Secure Dart Shelf and Dart Frog apps by setting HTTP security headers
data.what_it_does: Port of the NodeJS helmet package to Dart, providing middleware for Shelf and Dart Frog that automatically sets various HTTP security headers like Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, and Strict-Transport-Security.
use_when: You are building a backend or web application using Dart Shelf or Dart Frog.
You need to protect your web endpoints with standard HTTP security headers.
avoid_when: Your application does not use Dart Shelf, Dart Frog, or compatible middleware frameworks.
You prefer to manually construct and assign all security response headers yourself.
strengths: Wraps 13 individual security header middlewares into a single easy-to-use call.
Highly configurable options for individual headers and policies.
Out-of-the-box support for popular frameworks like Shelf, Dart Frog, and Pharaoh.
weaknesses: Not a silver bullet for overall application security.
Requires careful tuning of options like CSP to avoid breaking legitimate web page resources.
data.setup_notes: Add the package via `dart pub add shelf_helmet` and integrate it into your middleware pipeline.
